work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCXXIII to Archbishop-elect José da Silva Torres of Goa binds him to Multa praeclare and the decrees on the apostolic vicariates; address LF39923–39925 (foot of leaf 291 left), intitulation LF39929 after the right-column folio, greeting, body, blessing and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF39929–39929; the source dating clause at LF40029–40032 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Mariam Maiorem sub annulo piscatoris die octava iulii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo tertio, pontifi- catus Nostri anno decimo tertio. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
